name: Submission Clinic System
description: John Danaher’s Kimura: Enter The System covers dorsal and T-kimura topics, alternative submissions and positional changes from guard and takedown situations.
summary: Kimura finishing, positional transitions and alternative submissions from a shared control.
overview: Kimura: Enter The System treats the kimura as both a submission and a way of changing position. John Danaher covers dorsal and T-kimura situations, defensive grip problems and transitions to back attacks or other submissions. The course fits someone who wants options beyond finishing the shoulder lock itself.

related_content.name: Edwin Najmi Submission Attack System
related_content.relationship: Mission Submission offers separate darce, triangle and Estima-lock sections rather than building the course around kimura control.

products.title: Kimura: Enter The System
products.blurb: An eight-volume course on kimura control, finishing and positional or submission transitions.
products.best_for: Grapplers seeking several attacking options from kimura control.

guide.display_title: John Danaher: Kimura Control and Attacks

fits: You want positional transitions and alternative attacks from kimura control.
You want kimura entries from guard, top positions and takedown exchanges.

includes: Grip and arm-position mechanics, dorsal kimuras and reinforced-hand defenses.
T-kimura connections to the back, triangles, arm bars and leg entanglements.
Entries from pins, guard, turtle and standing or single-leg exchanges.
limits: The eight volumes are organized around kimura control; they do not survey all submission families equally.
